claim: SPARKOH! (formerly Le Pass) in Frameries charges €25 adults, €20 children 4-18 and seniors, free under 4, with school-holiday daily 10am-6pm hours.
quote: Children (4-18 years): €20; Adults (18+ years): €25; Seniors (65+): €20 ... School holidays: Daily 10am-6pm

claim: SPARKOH! offers 12,000 m² of themed indoor spaces plus 6,000 m² outdoor with a 4D cinema, indoor adventure course and a biodiversity garden geared at families.
quote: 12,000 m² of themed indoor spaces and 6,000 m² of outdoor areas with interactive exhibitions, a unique cinema with projection on 5 screens in 4D, fun challenges, an indoor adventure course, a Biodiversity Garden

claim: Brasserie Saint-Feuillien in Le Roeulx runs Saturday-only guided tours at 2pm/2:30pm, €12 adults including tasting of 2 beers, €8 children 6-18, free under 6, with closures 23 Feb–16 Mar 2026.
quote: Guided tour of the Brewery: only organised on Saturdays at 2pm or 2.30pm ... Adults (18+): €12 including tasting ... Children (6-18): €8 without tasting ... closed on: February 23 – March 16

claim: Brasserie de l'Abbaye des Rocs at Montignies-sur-Roc opens Sunday tours from 11am at €5/person and uses well water with no artificial flavours.
quote: Visits (approximately 1 hour) are available on Sundays from 11 a.m. ... 5 euros per person ... no artificial flavors, no taste enhancers, and no added sugar

claim: Brasserie Caulier in Péruwelz brews Bon Secours, Paix Dieu and Stuut at about a million litres per year and offers guided tours ending in a supervised tasting (€12 adults), shop open Wed-Sat 10am-12:30pm and 1:30pm-6pm.
quote: The brewery produces a million liters of beers per year under different brands like Paix Dieu, Bon Secours, and Stuut ... shop is open Wednesday to Saturday from 10am to 12:30pm and 1:30pm to 6pm

claim: Brasserie Brootcoorens in Erquelinnes (Angélus beers) is open Saturdays 9am-12pm and 1:30pm-5pm and runs the only educational hop garden in Wallonia with ~300 hop plants.
quote: open on Saturdays from 9h to 12h and from 13h30 to 17h ... educational hop field located in front of its buildings, composed of approximately 300 hop plants

claim: Brasserie de Blaugies (Dour) is a small production brewery open Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat 3:30pm-6:30pm and Sunday 10am-12:30pm with on-site Le Fourquet restaurant pairing local dishes to its beers.
quote: Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays from 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM, and Sundays from 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM ... has a restaurant serving local dishes that pair perfectly with the beers

claim: Maison Losseau in Mons (Art Nouveau house museum) is open Fri-Sun 1pm-6pm with Wednesday family/school days, €9 adults, €7 reduced, free under 6, and a €12 combo ticket with the Mundaneum.
quote: Friday-Sunday: 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM ... Adults: €9; Children (6+): €7; Children under 6: Free ... Maison Losseau + Mundaneum: €12

claim: Mons Sunday market runs 8am-2pm across Place Nervienne, Place du Béguinage and Rue Buisseret, with a flower market at Place Léopold the same hours.
quote: Le marché du dimanche, de 08h00 à 14h00 : Place Nervienne / Place du Béguinage / Rue Buisseret ... floral market on Sundays from 8 AM to 2 PM at Place Léopold

claim: Saint-Ghislain hosts no Sunday market; its weekly markets are Wednesday morning Grand-Place, Friday morning Baudour, Saturday morning Tertre and Tuesday afternoon Neufmaison.
quote: Saint-Ghislain has markets on Wednesday morning at the Grand-Place, Friday morning at Place de Baudour, Saturday morning at Place de Tertre, and Tuesday afternoon at Place de Neufmaison

claim: Escape Room Mons in the city centre runs themed rooms including Casa de Papel (heist) and SAW (horror) suitable for groups of friends or family.
quote: an immersive activity in Mons full of adrenaline and surprises for friends, family, or colleagues ... espionage escape game in the center of Mons

claim: The Mundaneum in Mons is a unusual archive-museum about Paul Otlet's pre-internet card-index utopia, free on the first Sunday of the month, exhibits across 3 floors with multi-lingual videos.
quote: regarded as the precursor to the modern internet ... 3 floors brings the story to light with exhibits and multi-lingual videos. Entry is free on the first Sunday of the month
